tr: Hello, nice to meet you for the first time. / Hi! Nice to meet you.
Thank you for helping. / Not at all.
Sorry I'm late. / It's fine, I just got here too.
How much is this? / 12,000 won.
Excuse me, where's the bathroom? / Go straight that way.
What can I get you? / This one, to go.
Are you okay? Hurt? / Yes, I'm fine.
Sorry, please speak slowly. / Ah, sure, I'll slow down.
Your Korean is good! / No, I'm still not good.
Excuse me, coming through. / Go ahead.

Excuse me, please help me. / Sure, what do you need?
Sorry, say that again please. / The subway station is on the left.

What is this? / Tteokbokki. It's a bit spicy.

Where are you from? / From the Philippines. Cebu.
Excuse me, how old are you? / 28. And you?
What do you do? / I work at an IT company.
Do you study Korean? / Yes, a little every day.
What's your hobby? / Running and music.
Long time no see! How've you been? / Good, thanks. You?
How are things lately? / Busy. But fun.
Nice weather today. / Yes, perfect for a walk.
What are you doing this weekend? / Going hiking. Want to come?
Today was fun. See you again! / Yes, I'll be in touch.
I'll head out first. Goodbye (stay well). / Bye (go well).
I'm bored. Let's hang out! / Deal! Where should we meet?
Are you free tomorrow? / In the afternoon. Why?
I'm going to a café, wanna come? / Sure, let's go.
I'm hungry. Wanna go eat? / Yes! What should we eat?
When should we meet? / How about Saturday?
Where should we meet? / Let's meet at Gangnam station exit 11.

Ready to order? / One iced Americano, please.
For here? / No, to go.
What sizes do you have? / Tall, grande, venti.
Do you have a points card? / No, that's okay.
Please heat this up. / Sure, it takes a minute.
Do you need a bag? / Yes, one please.
Cash or card? / Card.

Where does it hurt? / My head hurts. I have a fever too.
Do you have painkillers? / Yes, take these after a meal.
Do you have allergies? / Yes, I'm allergic to peanuts.
How many times a day? / Three times, 30 minutes after meals.
Package! / Please leave it at the door.
How much is rent? / 500,000 won, maintenance included.
Can you dry clean this? / Yes, pick it up tomorrow afternoon.
I'm starting work with you today. Please take care of me. / Likewise.
How are things? / So-so. Just busy.
I'm a coffee addict. / Me too! At least three cups a day.
I'm going to Korea next month. / Really? Where to?
I should get going. Goodbye. / Okay, get home safe.
See you next time. / Yes, I'll be in touch!
Hey, what are you doing? / Watching Netflix at home. Why?
Are you free tonight? / Yeah, after seven.
Wanna come over? I'll order chicken. / Deal! I'll bring beer.
Today was so fun. Let's hang again. / Sure, see you next week!
Can I get your number? / Sure, 010-3322-7788.
Do you have Instagram? / Yes, I'll give you my handle.
Today was lovely. Shall we meet again? / Sure. This time it's on me.
It's late. I'll walk you home. / It's fine, I can take the subway.
You look pretty today. / Thanks. I got a haircut.
You're here! I missed you. / Me too. Did you wait long?
Did you get home safe? / Yeah, just got in. Thanks for today.
I'm going to sleep. Night! / Okay, sweet dreams.
Did you eat? / Not yet. Wanna eat together?
What are you up to? / Just lying around. Bored.
Where are you? Almost here? / Sorry, five minutes! Just got off the subway.
I think I'll be late. / No worries, take your time. I'll be at the café.
Look at this meme lol / That's hilarious lol
I made this. / Wow, that's cool! How did you make it?
I passed the exam! / Really? Nice job!
I worked overtime today… / You worked hard. Get some rest.
Wanna grab a drink after work? / Love to! Where?

What are you doing tomorrow? / I'm off tomorrow. Why?
What time is it now? / Half past two.
What time is it? / 9:10.
How's the weather in Seoul? / Cold today, and the fine dust is bad.
Is it raining outside? / Yes, take an umbrella.
You look tired. / Yeah, I couldn't sleep last night.
I'm bored. / Then shall we watch a movie?
I won the lottery! / No way! How much?
I lost my wallet… / Oh no! Did you check with the police?
My presentation is tomorrow. / You got this! You can do it.
Please eat plenty. / Thank you, I will!
May I have your name? / I'm Kim Minsu.
Please sit here. / Thank you.
Anyone home? / Yes, come in!
Teacher, have you been well? / Yes, thanks to you. Long time no see.
Would you mind taking a photo? / Of course. One, two, three!
What are we? / Hmm… I like you. Want to go out?
Why didn't you text yesterday? / Sorry, my fault. Don't be mad.
How is it being with me? / I feel comfortable. That's the best part.
Can I hold your hand? / Yeah… is it because you're cold?
It's our 100th day today! / Really? Happy 100 days. I got you something.
I have something to tell you. / What is it? Is something wrong?
What time is the meeting? / Two. Meeting room B.
When is the deadline? / Friday, 6 PM.
Manager, do you have a moment? / Yes, come in.
I'll head out first. / Okay, good work today.
There's a team dinner today. / What time and where?
What should we have for lunch? / How about kimchi stew?
Ugh, I'm bored. What should I do? / Come out. Let's get chicken.
I'm so tired today. / Sleep early. See you tomorrow.
Where are you? / On my way. 10 minutes!
What's with him? / Dunno. I'm curious too.
I saved us seats. / You really are the best.
Karaoke tonight? / Let's go! My treat.
I think I'll bomb the presentation. / Don't worry. Just do it like you practiced.
Finally done. / Nice work. A beer?
How's this? Just bought it. / Cute. It suits you.
I miss you. / Me too. Let's meet this weekend.
I like you. / …Me too. You should've said sooner.
Babe, what are you doing? / Thinking about you, obviously.
I'm heading out now. / Get home safe. Text me when you arrive.
Sleepy. Going to bed. / Okay, sweet dreams.
Why are you smiling like that? / Your smile just now made my heart skip.
Why'd you text? / No reason. I keep thinking about you.
You said you had something to say? / I think I like you.
What are we? / Let's date.
I passed! / Really? Congrats!
I'll go first. / Don't go. Stay a little longer.
Long time no see. / I missed you. Been well?
Who's your bias? / The main vocalist.
What are you listening to lately? / I became a fan of this group. Their stage is amazing.
What are you doing this weekend? / Going to a concert! I even bought a light stick.
I'm a fan! Please sign this. / Sure, thanks. What's your name?
They're making a comeback this month. / Really? Did you see the teaser?
How was the concert? / Got goosebumps during the singalong.
Are you on Instagram? / Yes, I just followed you.
Posted a photo. Hit like for me. / Already did.
Why did nobody laugh at my joke earlier? / It killed the mood…
How's the tteokbokki here? / Insanely good. I'm coming back.
This song is addictive. / For real, been listening all day.

What are you doing this weekend? / Having a meal with family.
Who did you come with? / With a friend.
Who's that? / That's my older brother.
Unni, how's this? / It suits you. Buy it.
Do you have siblings? / Yes, one younger sibling.
Teacher, I have a question. / Yes, go ahead.
That restaurant is closed on Mondays. / Ah, really? Then let's go on Tuesday.
This is a cake I made. / Wow, it's really pretty!
Minsu, I'm here. / Oh, you're here? Come in.
Want to have lunch tomorrow? / Yeah, sure. What time?
What do you want to eat? / Hmm… bibimbap today.
I bought this with my first paycheck. / Oh, nice!
This is Namsan Tower. / Whoa, you can see all of Seoul!
I'm getting married next month. / Oh my, really? Congratulations!
Ouch! I banged my hand on the door. / Are you OK? Let me see.
Your face has gone red! / Oh, come on, stop looking.
Do you think this movie will be good? / Well, I'm not sure.
I saw BTS yesterday. / Come on, no way!
They say there's no team dinner today. / Yes! I'm going home early.
It's already eleven. / Yikes, I have to hurry!
Oops, I spilled the coffee! / It's fine, I'll wipe it up.
Did you bring an umbrella? / Oh no, I left it at home.
Is your exam over? / Yes, phew, now I need some rest.
Overtime again today? / Sigh, yes. There's too much work.
Shh, the baby is sleeping. / Oh, sorry. I'll be quiet.
Right, shall we start now? / Yes, let's start!
Hello? Is that Minji? / Yes, it's me. What's up?
This bag is a million won. / Oh my god, that's way too expensive!
Boo! / Ah, you scared me! That made me jump.
Aaah, a bug! / Stay still. I'll get it.
Ta-da! It's your birthday present. / Wow, thank you! What is it?
This milk is past its date. / Yuck, I already drank some!
You look even prettier today. / Really? I changed my hair a bit.
My name is Haneul. / Even your name is pretty.
Why are you so cute? / Oh, stop joking.
You're even better-looking in person. / Haha, I guess my photos don't do me justice.
You look cool when you're working. / Out of nowhere? Thank you.
You have a pretty smile. / Thank you. That's the first time I've heard that.
Your eye smile is really pretty. / Oh, come on, I'm embarrassed.
What's the occasion? You actually called. / I just wanted to hear your voice.
What do you think of me? / Honestly, you're totally my type.
What's your ideal type? / Hmm… someone who laughs a lot.
I liked my first impression of you. / Me too. I felt comfortable from the start.
Have you eaten? / Not yet. Want to eat together?
Want to come up for some ramyeon? / Haha, that's the line from the movie, right? I'm heading home tonight.
Want to have dinner together this weekend? / Sure, when shall we meet?
I had a great time today. Can I contact you? / Thanks for the thought, but I'm fine.
Can I see you again? / Sorry, but I'm seeing someone.
After class, I'll buy you a coffee. / You're a lovely person, but I'd like to stay friends.
The food is really delicious. / Oh, it's nothing special. Eat plenty.
How did you make this? / It's easy. I'll show you next time.
You're really good at this. / Oh no, I still have a long way to go.
I read your report. You're so thorough. / Thanks for seeing it that way.
You're forty? You look so young for your age. / You're praising me too much.
Your child is so cute. / Thank you. At home he's a little troublemaker.
That outfit suits you. / Thank you for the compliment.
Your pronunciation is really good. / Oh no. It's all thanks to my teacher.
I learned a lot from your presentation today. / Don't mention it. Thanks for listening.
